 Oral Order
1.
Learned HCGP accepts notice for respondent No.1-State.

2. The petitioners--accused Nos.1 to 5 who are being prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 323, 506, and 504 read with Section 34 of the IPC, and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, have approached this Court seeking quashing of the proceedings in C.C.
No.57621/2019 pending on the file of the XI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (ACMM),
Bengaluru.

3. The prosecution alleges that accused No.1 is the husband, and accused Nos.2 to 5 are the complainant's mother-in-law, father-in-law, sister-in-law, and brother-in-law, respectively, and that they subjected the complainant to both mental and physical cruelty, abused her in filthy language,
and assaulted her.
4.
The parties are present before the Court and have filed an application for compounding, along with their respective affidavits, stating that they have amicably resolved the dispute among themselves.
In terms of the settlement, the de facto complainant has reunited with her husband and is now leading a cordial marital life.

It is further stated that the de facto complainant, who is present before the Court, has agreed to withdraw all allegations against accused Nos.1 to 5 and has no objection to quashing the impugned proceedings in order to maintain peace and harmony in the marital relationship.
The application for compounding is placed on record.

6. Although the offences alleged are cognizable and non- compoundable, in view of the fact that the parties have amicably resolved the dispute among themselves, subjecting the petitioners--accused Nos.1 to 5 to trial would be a futile exercise, especially since the probability of conviction is remote and bleak in light of the settlement.
Under these circumstances, continuation of the impugned proceedings would amount to an abuse of the process of law.

7. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The petition is allowed;

3 ii) impugned proceedings in C.C.No.57621/2009 (arising out of Crime No.203/2017 of Pulakeshi Nagar Police Station), pending on the file of XI ACMM Court, Bangalore for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 506 read with 34 of IPC are hereby quashed.
